strings.으, 바쁘다. 바빠. 어라, %s 씨…. 쉬고 있던 거 아니었어?: Ugh, so much to do! Oh, %s... Weren't you resting?
I was resting at the inn, but something came to mind.
strings.혹시 우리 자매 이야기를 하고 싶어서 온 거야?: Did you want to ask about my sister and me?
No, it isn't about your sister.
Really? Thank you. Hehe. I hate attracting unnecessary attention.
strings.그건 그렇고 내가 맞춰볼까? %s 씨가 무슨 생각 하는지…. 오네이로 숲: Then let me guess what's on your mind, %s... You're worried about that girl you met in Oneiro Forest!
Edda, was it? I saw her too. I went there on business once... The girl with the golem seemed perfectly ordinary.
strings.%s씨가 봤을 때, 소녀의 등 뒤에 마수의 팔 같은 게 달려있었다고?: But when you saw her, %s, she had something like a monster's arm growing out of her back?
strings.분명 베르겔미르는 그 아이가 죽으면서 저주에서 벗어났다고 했어요. 그리고: Bergelmir said she was freed from her curse when she died. He also thanked me for helping someone named Shynic and destroying Ixion.
strings.동방 대륙 이야기인가 보군. 그것까지는 잘 몰라, 미안해. %s 씨가 동: That must have happened in Eastland. Sorry, I don't know much about that. I do know you've been meeting Eastland's Champions, %s...
strings.아, 샤이닉이라면 초인 중 하나였지?: Ah, Shynic is one of the Champions, right?
Actually, I shouldn't go straight there.
strings.잘 생각했어. 그러면 오네이로 숲으로 먼저 가야겠지? 빛의 연합과 실바리: Good thinking. You'll want to visit Oneiro Forest first. The Alliance of Light and the Silvaria Empire's mages have purified it, so you should be all right.
There might be evidence they overlooked. Have a look around.
strings.저번에 느껴봐서 알지? %s 씨처럼 그곳을 한 번 찾은 사람은 금방 또: You felt it last time, didn't you? Once you've been there, like you have, %s, it's easy to find again.
It's nothing... Just don't get overconfident.
President, you're in! There's a new kind of bread, so I brought you some.
Thank you. Perfect timing. I have a favor to ask.
strings.혹시 모르니까 %s 씨 뒤를 따라가. 위험한 일 생기면 도와주고. 나중에: Follow %s, just in case. Help if anything dangerous happens, and report back to me right away afterward.
strings.그런 거라면 바로 가볼게요. 흐음…. 라클렛한테도 이거 가져다 줘야 하는: I'll get going, then. Hmm... I need to bring some of this to Raclette too...
strings.라클렛 녀석, 제대로 먹지도 않잖아. 그냥 나 다 줘. 내가 나르샤랑 다: Raclette barely eats anyway. Just leave it all with me. Narsha and I will finish it. Now hurry along, all right?
strings.심심한 날, 친구가 필요한 날, 마력으로 친구 인형 같은 거 라도 만들까: On a boring day, when you need a friend... Maybe I should make myself a friend out of magic? Waaah, I'm bored...
strings.샤이닉 님, 잠깐 뛰고 오시는 건 어떠신가요?: Lady Shynic, why not go for a short run?
strings.뛰는 건 귀찮아! 땀 흘리는 건 질색이라고!: Running is too much work! I hate getting sweaty!
strings.예전에 칼리 마을에 펼쳐진 결계까지 뛰어가 튕겨 나가시는 걸 즐기셨다고: I heard you used to enjoy running into Kali Village's barrier and bouncing off it. How about that?
Of course. She must have been terribly annoyed over that business with %s last time.
strings.놀려볼까? 쟤는 놀리는 재미가 있으니까…. 멜빅, 나 모른 척해. 저기에: Should I give our friend a scare? Always such fun to tease... Melvic, pretend you haven't seen me. I'll hide over there.
Of course, Lady Shynic. I hope you enjoy yourself.
strings.(샤이닉이 건물 뒤에 숨어있다가 %s의 모습이 보일 때쯤 고양이 같은 포: (Shynic hides behind a building, then leaps out in a catlike pose as %s approaches.)
strings.어으, 깜짝이야!! 어, 어흥은 또 뭐예요?: Aah! You scared me! What's with the roaring?
You know that saying? Speak of the tiger, and it appears.
strings.에잉, 재미없는 반응…. (죽일까?) (중얼중얼) 무슨 일이 있어서 온: Aww, what a boring reaction... (Should I kill you?) (Mumble, mumble.) Looks like you came for a reason... What is it? Anything interesting?
I could swear I just heard something dangerous... Anyway, look at this.
strings.(샤이닉에게 오네이로 숲에서 발견한 낡은 리본을 건네준다.): (You hand Shynic the old ribbon you found in Oneiro Forest.)
strings.(샤이닉이 리본을 받아들고 아무런 말도 하지 못한다.): (Shynic takes the ribbon and falls silent.)
No, it couldn't be... Just a coincidence. This ribbon...
strings.(샤이닉이 머리를 묶은 리본을 풀어 손에 있는 리본과 비교한다.): (Shynic unties the ribbon in her hair and compares it with the one in her hand.)
To my dear Shynic... To my dear Shynic...
strings.(샤이닉에게 오네이로 숲에서 에다란 소녀를 봤다고 말한다. 그리고 있었던: (You tell Shynic about the girl named Edda you saw in Oneiro Forest, and explain what happened.)
strings.(샤이닉이 에다의 이름을 부르다 주저앉는다. 샤이닉의 상태가 이상한 것: (Repeating Edda's name, Shynic sinks to the ground. Something is wrong. She seems to be panicking...)
strings.샤이닉 님!! 괜찮으신가요?: Lady Shynic!! Are you all right?
strings.(샤이닉이 정신을 잃고 쓰러진다. 깜짝 놀란 멜빅이 샤이닉을 안고 서둘러: (Shynic loses consciousness and collapses. A startled Melvic gathers her into his arms and hurries to her room.)
strings.대체 무슨 일이 있었기에 저런 거지…?: What could have happened to make her react like that...?
strings.(잠시 후, 멜빅이 %s의 앞에 나타난다. 무척 걱정스러운 표정이다.): (A little later, Melvic returns to %s, looking deeply worried.)
Lady Shynic has stabilized for now, but...
strings.아무래도 지난 기억 때문에 힘들어하시는 것 같습니다. 샤이닉 님을 괴롭게: I think memories of the past are distressing her. Memories that torment her...
strings.%s 님, 부탁드릴 게 있습니다. 일단 메디아 님께 사정을 설명하고 도움: %s, may I ask a favor? Could you explain the situation to Lady Medea and ask for her help?
Of course. This seems to be my fault. I'll go right away.
Thank you. I'll stay here and watch over Lady Shynic.
strings.당신이군요. 타르타로스로 향하던 바람의 기운이 달라져 있던데…. 혹시 샤: It's you. I sensed a change in the winds blowing toward Tartaros... Is this about Shynic?
strings.메디아 님은 어디까지 알고 계시는 거죠?: How much do you know, Medea?
strings.그냥 느끼는 것뿐, 복잡하게 생각하지 않으셔도 됩니다. 자, 이야기하세요: I merely sense these things. Don't worry about how. Tell me what happened.
strings.샤이닉 님이 그런 반응을 보일 줄 몰랐어요. 오네이로 숲에 있던 소녀가: I didn't know she would react that way. I never imagined the girl in Oneiro Forest would have something like that...
strings.우리는 인간입니다. 비록 보통 사람과는 다른 조금 특별한 힘을 가지고 있: We are human. We simply possess powers a little different from those of ordinary people. Yes, those powers... They are both a blessing and a curse.
strings.그리고 완벽할 수 없는 존재를 완벽하다고 인식하는 것…, 그게 당신을 비: Believing imperfect beings to be perfect... That is a mistake ordinary people make, yourself included.
strings.저한테 사과하지 않으셔도 됩니다. 인간이 가지고 있는 약한 점일 뿐이니까: You needn't apologize to me. It is simply a human weakness. Explain things to Shynic when she wakes.
For now, I will make some medicine that should help her.
Ah... I don't have the ingredients.
strings.제가 구해올게요. 어디서 구해오면 될까요?: I'll get them. Where should I look?
strings.어쩔 수 없군요. 라피어에서 환영의 씨앗을 가져오세요. 트락투스들이 가지: Very well. Bring me a Seed of Illusion from Lapier. It is different from the Illusion Tree Seeds the Tractus carry.
strings.좀처럼 보이지 않는 재료라 구하기 힘들 텐데…. 그래도 당신이라면 찾아올: The ingredient rarely appears, so it may be difficult to find... But I believe you can manage.
strings.아, 그동안 세계의 다른 면을 보고 왔군요. 보통은 갈 수 없는 공간일: Ah, you've seen another side of the world since we last met. It is a place people cannot ordinarily enter...
I'll find it as quickly as I can. Please wait for me.
Much the same as before. I didn't sense anything ominous.
strings.이 재료로 약을 만드는 것도 참 오랜만이네요. 그때는 샤이닉의 곁에 있던: It has been a long time since I last used this ingredient to make medicine. That time, it was for the boy who stayed by Shynic's side...
strings.잠시만 기다려주세요. 오래 걸리지 않을 겁니다. 기다리시는 동안 차를 내: Please wait a moment. It won't take long. I'll pour you some tea while you wait. Here...
strings.(메디아가 차를 건네주고 약을 만드는 일에 집중한다.): (Medea gives you some tea, then turns her attention to making the medicine.)
It's the tea you served last time. I remember its lovely fragrance.
strings.자, 됐습니다. 이걸 샤이닉에게 먹이세요. 이런 상황으로 그가 죽을 일은: There, it's ready. Have Shynic drink this. Her condition won't kill her, of course...
No, it couldn't kill her. But this should help calm her.
All right. I'll be going, then.
Is there nothing you wish to ask me? It seems you have met Weiss...
strings.당신이 모시는 신을 위해 필요한 힘이 제게도 있는데, 머뭇거리시는 것 같: I, too, possess power needed by the god you serve, but you seem hesitant...
Even if I want it, I don't think now is the time. You told me to visit often so you could learn to trust me.
strings.이제 가보세요. 당신의 방문을 막지는 않을테니, 나중에 또 오시는 걸로: Go now. You are welcome here, so I shall expect another visit.
All right. I'll see you again, Medea.
Lady Medea, I saw someone following %s after the adventurer left. I wasn't sure what was happening, so I thought I should report it.
strings.베이넌, 그건 신경 쓰지 않아도 됩니다. 그들은 그들 나름대로 사명을 다: You needn't concern yourself with that, Beinan. They are fulfilling their own duty.
strings.네, 알겠습니다. 메디아 님께서 그러시니 그런 거겠죠. 그런데 이런 상자: Understood. If you say so, Lady Medea. They did leave all these boxes behind, though. They seem to contain food...
Come to think of it, your manner of speaking has changed thanks to %s, Beinan. For the better, of course.
Ah, this is... cake. I haven't seen one in a while. There's a card, too...
strings.「메디아 님의 탄생일을 축하합니다. - 몽글몽글 길드」: "Happy birthday, Lady Medea. —The Mongle Mongle Guild"
strings.제 탄생일을 어떻게 알고…. 아, 다른 대륙의 그 사람이라면 가능하겠군요: How did they know my birthday...? Ah, that person on the other continent would know.
strings.메디아 님, 초는 몇 개나 꽂을까요? 일단 많이 꽂으셔야 할 것 같은데…: Lady Medea, how many candles should I put on it? I imagine we'll need quite a lot...
I take back the compliment. You really have no tact...
strings.괜찮습니다. 대신 마을 사람들을 불러주세요. 맛있는 음식은 다 같이 먹어: It's all right. Go and invite the villagers instead. Good food should be shared.
strings.지금 조금 안정되셨는데, 그래도 조금 불안합니다. 아무래도 이 리본이 샤: She's a little calmer now, but I'm still worried. That ribbon seems to have touched something deep inside her...
I brought medicine Medea made for her. Here...
Thank you. I'll give Lady Shynic the medicine...
strings.(멜빅이 샤이닉에게 약을 먹인다. 힘없이 축 처져 있던 샤이닉의 얼굴에: (Melvic gives Shynic the medicine. Color returns to her previously listless face.)
strings.샤이닉 님, 괜찮으신가요?: Lady Shynic, are you all right?
strings.어? 내가 죽기라도 했을까 봐?: What? Worried I might actually have died?
If she's making jokes like that, she must be fine...
strings.(샤이닉에게 메디아에게 사정을 설명하고 약을 받아왔다고 한다.): (You tell Shynic that you explained the situation to Medea and brought back medicine.)
strings.그 약이라면 예전에 멜빅 살릴 때 먹인 약이네. 나한테도 효과가 있었나?: That's the medicine I gave Melvic to save his life. It works on me too?
Ah, so that was the same medicine, Lady Shynic.
strings.그래. 맞아. 그나저나 나도 멜빅처럼 몇십 년 뒤에 깨어났으면 어떻게 하: Yes, exactly. What was she thinking, sending it over? What if I'd taken decades to wake up, like you?
I will always be grateful to you for making it possible for me to be here...
strings.됐어. 그 이야기 듣자고 널 살린 거 아니니까. 그건 그렇고 메디아한테는: Enough. I didn't save you to hear you thank me. Anyway, I'll have to visit Medea sometime and thank her♡
Melvic, I'm fine. Perfectly fine. Where's the ribbon? Ah, here...
Yes, I'm fine. I have to be. Now I'll tell you my story, %s... Want to listen too, Melvic?
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 안 그래도 노엘 씨하고 상단 관련 일로 이야기할게 있어서: I'll leave you to it. I need to speak with Noel about some trading company business.
strings.알았어. 그러면 %s, 따라와. 내 자리에서 네가 알고 싶은 이야길 해줄: All right. Come with me, then, %s. I'll tell you what you want to know back at my place♡
strings.짐작하는 그대로의 이야기겠지만…. 그럼 시작할까?: It's probably just what you've guessed... Shall I begin?
strings.사막에 자리 잡은 쥬드 왕국 한쪽에 아주 작은 마을이 있었어. 라틴스 마: There was a tiny village in a corner of the desert kingdom of Jude. Latins Village. That was my home.
strings.당시 데이모스 교단이 세력을 넓히면서 마을을 습격했지만, 다행히 어떤 마: The Deimos cult attacked as it expanded its reach, but a mage fought them off, and thankfully the village escaped serious damage.
Ixion. The man I cursed and hated so much.
strings.쥬드 왕국의 대마법사 익시온. 아이들이 보기에 그는 영웅이었어. 그래서: Ixion, the great mage of the Kingdom of Jude. To us children, he was a hero. We followed him and dreamed of becoming mages.
strings.익시온은 그런 아이들에게 너희도 마법사가 될 수 있다 꼬셨고, 부모에게도: He lured us in by promising we could become mages too. He told our parents he would take us away and train us into great mages, and they agreed.
strings.그중엔 나도, 에다도 있었어. 아이들은 자기도 쥬드 왕국의 마법사가 될: Edda and I were among those children. We all believed we'd become mages of the Kingdom of Jude. I'm certain of it... But...
You don't have to tell me if it's too painful.
strings.괜찮아. 그럼 계속 들어. 어디 보자…. 아, 아이들은 익시온을 따라 모: It's fine. Just listen. Where was I...? Ah, the children followed Ixion to Moros and began studying magic in a place called the shelter.
strings.하지만, 뭔가 달랐어. 어떤 힘이 주입됐지만, 의심하지 않았어. 그저 마: But something was wrong. They injected us with some kind of power, but we never questioned it. It all seemed as wondrous as magic...
strings.친구들이랑 같이 있어서 재미있었고, 암흑 전쟁에서 그 마법으로 데이모스: It was fun being with our friends, and we believed we could protect people by defeating the Deimos cult's fanatics with that magic in the Dark War.
strings.단순히 그런 줄 알았지. 하지만, 뭔가 잘못됐다는 건 좀 지나서 알게 됐: We thought that was all there was to it. Only later did we realize something was wrong.
strings.이상한 힘이 더 주입됐고, 그걸 견디지 못했던 아이들의 몸에서 이상한 것: They kept pouring that strange power into us. Children who couldn't endure it began growing strange things from their bodies. They were no longer human...
strings.그래도 난 그런 게 없었지만, 그래도 부작용이 있었어. 내가 자라지 않: That didn't happen to me, but I had side effects too. I stopped growing. I couldn't die...
I had to go to war and kill people with no control over myself...
strings.정신을 차리면 수천 수만의 피를 뒤집어 쓴 병기가 있었어. 그때부터 난: Whenever I came to, there was a weapon drenched in the blood of thousands, tens of thousands. That's when I understood. I could never be the person I'd been before.
strings.그래도 암흑 전쟁이 끝나면 멈출 수 있을 거라 생각했어. 하지만, 익시온: Still, I thought it would stop when the Dark War ended. But then Ixion began disposing of the children who were no longer useful...
strings.전쟁이 끝나고 고향으로 돌아갈 수 있을 줄 알았는데…. 익시온이 잠시 속: I thought we could go home when the war ended... When Ixion briefly loosened his binding, I escaped with the other children...
strings.익시온의 그 힘이 또 우리를 옭아맸고, 폭주시켰어. 순간, 나는 깨달았지: But that power of his caught us again and drove us berserk. In that moment, I realized it would only end if I killed Ixion...
strings.하지만, 그 땐 정신이 없었고 살아남아야 했어. 거기서 유일하게 살아남은: But I couldn't think clearly then. I had to survive. I thought I was the only one who made it out... But Edda was alive...
Edda loved flowers and trees. She was always making decorations with them. She liked making clothes, too...
strings.조금만 일찍…. 조금만 일찍 알아볼 걸…. 내가 조금만 더 일찍 가볼 걸: If only I'd known... If only I'd looked a little sooner... If I'd only gone a little earlier.
strings.(샤이닉의 눈가에 눈물이 맺히다 이내 떨어진다.): (Tears gather in Shynic's eyes and begin to fall.)
strings.응, 괜찮아. 그럼 내 이야길 더 들어줘. 싫다고 해도 계속 이야기할 거: Yes, I'm fine. Now listen to the rest. I'll keep talking even if you don't want to hear it♡
strings.고향으로 돌아가면 다 끝날 줄 알았는데, 전쟁 때문에 가보지 못하는 동안: I thought everything would be over if I went home, but while the war kept me away, my home disappeared.
strings.그래도 덕분에 이렇게 멋진 도시도 만들고, 날 죽이러 오는 놈들 잡아 나: Still, that's how I came to build this wonderful city, catch the people who come to kill me, and throw them into the Abyss Chamber... I even locked Ixion up here when he came for me...
You were the one who finished him off, but it's all right now...
strings.왜 그렇게 울상이야. 난 괜찮으니까. 후우, 이런 이야기를 하는 건 멜빅: Why the long face? I'm fine. Whew. I haven't told anyone this since Melvic and Medea.
strings.하여튼 고마워. 앞으로 널 죽이고 싶은 마음이 들어도 죽이지 않을게♡: Anyway, thank you. Even if I feel like killing you from now on, I won't♡
I'll tell you one more thing.
I wasn't going to tell you, but... Hmm.
strings.그걸 알고 싶어? 그러면 내가 신뢰할 수 있을 때까지 재미있는 걸 계속: Want to know? Then keep bringing me interesting things until I can trust you♡
